events.name: Bash
events.head: Survey probe, logo map, and running servers
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; head -40 app/scripts/probe-funnel-boards.mjs; grep -n "amazon\|youtube\|slack\|apollo\|const LOGO\|HeadCtx" app/src/components/masterclass/funnel-os.tsx | head -30; grep -n -i "amazon\|youtube\|slack\|apollo" app/src/components/masterclass/funnel-os-types/{book,hub-spoke,waterfall}.tsx | head -30; lsof -iTCP -sTCP:LISTEN -P | grep node | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check marks, Slack/Apollo, history, dev server
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; ls app/public/brand/logos/tools/ | grep -i "amazon\|youtube\|slack"; grep -n -i "slack\|apollo" app/src/components/masterclass/funnel-os.tsx app/src/components/masterclass/funnel-os-types/{book,hub-spoke,waterfall}.tsx | head; git log --oneline -6 -- app/src/components/masterclass/funnel-os.tsx; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" localhost:4322/funnels/book-call

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find drawn icons, lettered tiles, Mark implementation
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; F=app/src/components/masterclass/funnel-os-types; grep -n "logos:\|logo:\|Mark id\|tile\|Tile" $F/waterfall.tsx | head -20; grep -n "Play\|BookIcon\|<svg" $F/book.tsx $F/hub-spoke.tsx | head; sed -n 170,180p app/src/components/masterclass/funnel-os.tsx; grep -n "^export function Mark" -A15 app/src/components/masterclass/funnel-os.tsx | head -25

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find logo ids used but missing from map
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; F=app/src/components/masterclass; keys=$(sed -n 177,240p $F/funnel-os.tsx | grep -o '^  [a-z0-9]*:' | tr -d ' :' | sort -u); for f in $F/funnel-os-types/*.tsx $F/funnel-os*.tsx; do grep -o '"[a-z0-9]*"' $f | tr -d '"' | sort -u | while read id; do grep -q "logos\|logo:\|Mark id=\"$id\"\|\"$id\"" /dev/null; done; done; grep -ho 'logos: \[[^]]*\]\|logo: "[a-z0-9]*"\|Mark id="[a-z0-9]*"' $F/funnel-os-types/*.tsx $F/funnel-os*.tsx | grep -o '"[a-z0-9]*"' | tr -d '"' | sort -u > /tmp/used; echo "$keys" > /tmp/keys; comm -23 /tmp/used /tmp/keys; sed -n 130,
